coordinates.model_origin: the rotation axis, at the top face of the stator's F.Cu copper
coordinates.kicad_y: KiCad y points down. A model with y up uses y_model = -(y_kicad - 100); then every rotation sense below flips (KiCad 'counter-clockwise' = clockwise seen from +z in a y-up model)
coordinates.z: z up, from the stator towards the rotor. Stator F.Cu top face at z = 0; deeper layers at negative z

stator.copper: each layer's copper is 35 um thick and sits just below its z value (F.Cu: -0.035 ... 0)

rotor.placement: copper side towards the stator, NOT mirrored: take Rotor.kicad_pcb as drawn, put its copper face (facing down) at z = +air_gap, its FR-4 above it
rotor.rotation: turn by theta about the axis: (x, y) -> (x cos t - y sin t, x sin t + y cos t) in KiCad coordinates (y down). theta = 0 is the rotor exactly as drawn

air_gap_definition: stator F.Cu top face to rotor copper face (copper to copper). The solder mask lies inside this gap: air between the two mask faces = gap - 2 x mask thickness

solder_mask.where: both faces of the stator AND both faces of the rotor, over all copper and bare FR-4, no openings (vias tented). Conformal over the copper: 20 um on top of each trace and on the FR-4 between traces
solder_mask.note: no solder mask is set in the KiCad stackup of these boards, so this is a typical LPI value; the mask is a non-magnetic insulator: no effect on L, M or eddy currents, it changes only the stray capacitance and self resonance (openEMS C8)

air_box.note: about 3 x the board radius around everything (Elmer: zero tangential A on the outside; openEMS: MUR / PML at least 2.5 x the radius)

TX.how: the two coil ends lie stacked at this point on the two layers; the terminal (port / circuit electrode pair) goes between the two ends

2.source: the generator found no cut spot on this board; tools/kicad_to_openems.py takes the layer-change via farthest from the TX copper
2.how: leave this via out (opens the loop); the terminal goes between its two pads
